name: Fresh romaine salad kit through processor and foodservice DC
scenario_text: A farm harvests fresh romaine, cools it, and sends it to an initial packinghouse that assigns a lot. A fresh-cut processor receives the romaine, chops and mixes it into refrigerated salad kits, ships cases to a distribution center, and the distribution center receives and ships cases to restaurants.
